items.title: A proposed amendment to Institutional Planned Development 108, submitted by Chicago Realty Ventures, LLC, for the property generally located at 3700-3846 N Seminary Avenue, 1100-1156 W Grace Street, and 3801-3851 N Racine Avenue . The applicant proposes amending Planned Development 108 to extend the boundaries of the Planned Development and establish three subareas. The existing surface parking lot in Subarea A is proposed to include up to 800 parking stalls as previously granted via minor change on March 4, 2014. No changes are proposed to Subarea B, which contains an existing public park. Subarea C will include an existing surface parking lot with up to 103 parking spaces. The proposed maximum Floor Area Ratio (FAR) of all subareas is 1.2.

enrichment.relevance_reason: The amendment concerns parking lots and a park within an institutional planned development, with no residential units or housing regulation described.
enrichment.summary: Chicago Realty Ventures, LLC proposes amending Institutional Planned Development 108 at 3700-3846 N Seminary Ave to extend its boundaries and create three subareas, covering surface parking (up to 800 and 103 spaces) and an existing park, with a maximum FAR of 1.2.

items.title: A resolution seeking the adoption of the South Chicago Land Use Framework plan. This planning effort led by DPD establishes a framework for future land use recommendations in the South Chicago community area in the 7 th and 10 th wards. It evaluated land use, zoning, community priorities, and redevelopment opportunities in South Chicago, informed by a public engagement process and review of community-led planning initiatives. The recommendations of the land use framework will serve as a planning tool to support strengthening residential areas, foster thriving commercial corridors, and open spaces, and achieve other local priorities

attachments.label: South Chicago Land Use Framework Plan (Informational webpage)

enrichment.relevance_reason: The land use framework is a DPD planning tool guiding future zoning and land use recommendations, including strengthening residential areas, in South Chicago.
enrichment.summary: The Plan Commission is asked to adopt the South Chicago Land Use Framework, a DPD-led plan for the 7th and 10th wards. It evaluates land use, zoning, and redevelopment opportunities and recommends strategies to strengthen residential areas, commercial corridors, and open spaces.

items.title: A proposed Lakefront Protection Ordinance Application No. 805 and a proposed Residential Business Planned Development Application submitted by 2800 Sheridan Land LLC, for the redevelopment of the property generally located at 2800 N. Sheridan Road. The properties that are the subject of these applications are 2800-2828 N. Sheridan Road/400-418 W. Diversey Parkway and 2714-2750 N. Lakeview Avenue/401-419 W. Diversey Parkway. The new Planned Development is comprised of two sub-areas in abutting Wards with the property generally located at 2800 N. Sheridan Road to become Sub-Area A of the new Planned Development and incorporating the historic Elks National Memorial into the new Planned Development as Sub-Area B (43rd Ward). Sub-Area A is proposed to be improved with a 28-story mixed-use residential building containing 10,000 square feet of retail space, 50,000 square feet of fitness club space, 301 accessory car parking spaces and 345 bike parking spaces. The maximum number of dwelling units will be 345 and a maximum FAR of 5.0.

enrichment.relevance_reason: The Residential Business Planned Development would allow a 28-story mixed-use building with up to 345 dwelling units.
enrichment.summary: 2800 Sheridan Land LLC seeks Lakefront Protection Ordinance approval and a Residential Business Planned Development at 2800 N. Sheridan Road. Sub-Area A would have a 28-story mixed-use building with up to 345 dwelling units, retail, and a fitness club. The historic Elks National Memorial would be added as Sub-Area B.

items.title: A proposed Institutional Planned Development, submitted by Lake Park Associates, Inc., for the property generally located at 370 East Garfield Boulevard . items.title: A resolution seeking the adoption of the North Branch Framework Update for the Area South of Grand Avenue. Led by Department of Planning and Development, this framework update provides recommendations to guide future public and private projects in a manner consistent with the surrounding downtown development context for approximately 11 acres of the North Branch Industrial Corridor generally bounded by W. Grand Ave. on the north, the Union Pacific/Chicago North Western railroad tracks and portions of N. Jefferson Street on the east, W. Kinzie Street to the south and N. Desplaines Street to the west. The recommendations support mixed-used development at downtown density levels, multi-modal transportation including a transitway, and publicly accessible open spaces.

notices.title: CLIHTF landlord notices page updated
notices.detail:
Important November 2026 Notice
As we approach the end of 2026 and prepare for the new year, the Chicago Low-Income Housing Trust Fund (CLIHTF) would like to share several important program updates and reminders. Please take a moment to review the following information regarding payment procedures, policy changes, rent increases, and compliance requirements to help ensure a smooth transition into 2027.
1.) GETTING PAID BY TIPALTI: From November 16, the one-time code you use to sign in to Tipalti may arrive in WhatsApp instead of by text message. It will come from a Tipalti phone number and show Tipalti as the sender. How you sign in doesn't change. Only enter the code on the Tipalti sign-in page, and don't share it with anyone, including anyone who says they're from Tipalti.
2.) SRO units and apartments with more than two bedrooms are now exempt from CLIHTF’s Attrition Policy.
3.) If you received approval of a 2027 rent increase, remember the new rent does not take effect until each lease renews sometime in 2027. If you don’t know whether or not your 2027 Annual Rent Increase request was approved, please contact your Program Specialist.
4.) Strive to provide updated Exhibit I/1-I-2 Tenant Income Verification forms with proof of income documentation (POI) sixty (60) days before lease renewal. Also please remember we give staff thirty (30) days to review new leases and POI so submitting early is the best way to get paid by CLIHTF on time!
5.) Landlords in compliance with CLIHTF requirements are eligible for first quarter 2027 payments under the 2026 Rental Subsidy Agreement (RSA). We begin accepting payment requests on December 1, 2026.
The earliest we can pay first quarter 2027 subsidies on properties for which all 2026 inspections, leases and POI is current is January 8, 2027.
As we enter this season of giving thanks, please know we are thankful for you working with us to provide affordable housing in Chicago to the working poor as well as families exiting homelessne

enrichment.relevance_reason: The notice sets payment, attrition policy, rent increase, and compliance rules for landlords receiving Chicago Low-Income Housing Trust Fund rental subsidies for affordable units.
enrichment.summary: CLIHTF updated its landlord notices page with November 2026 program reminders: Tipalti payment sign-in codes may arrive via WhatsApp, SRO and 3+ bedroom units are exempt from the Attrition Policy, and first quarter 2027 subsidy requests open December 1, 2026.
